value.rationale: The polar Lipschitz body is a canonical metric dual in graph-polytope geometry; its intrinsic volume is a natural geometric invariant not determined by a graph’s facet count or inradius. The exact binomial-tail formula and quantitatively sharp exponential/linear/Gaussian regime transition provide structural, dimension-dependent information for a two-parameter family, including a nontrivial universal crossover function.
